Your TMDB API key and self-hosted server address will be deleted from this device, and KueTV will go back to the built-in shared service with its daily share.

The built-in service is shared by everyone using KueTV. If any minute, hourly or daily allowance is used up, TMDB details pause until that window resets; playlist information keeps working. Your own key or Worker removes this allowance.

If your TV switches cleanly, turn it on and see: you can change it back at any time.

What KueTV opens when it starts

On any device with a browser on the same Wi-Fi — a phone, a computer or another TV — scan the QR (or open the URL), enter this PIN, choose your KueTV backup file and send it. You then pick what to restore here.
KueTV player

Many providers never say how many channels you may watch at the same time, so KueTV finds out by opening a few and seeing which ones survive. Anything playing now will stop, and this can take up to two minutes.
KueTV could not work out how many channels this provider allows.
Resolve all KueTV domain lookups through a custom DNS server.

If a live channel has shown no picture by this time, KueTV stops trying and tells you, instead of leaving a black screen while it works through every player it has. Never keeps trying, which can take well over a minute on a channel your provider has removed. Waits your provider asks for are not counted.
Surround — send Dolby/DTS to a real 5.1/7.1 receiver. If it goes silent or stutters, KueTV still falls back to stereo and tells you.

KueTV is a media player only. It includes no channels, playlists, or content. You are responsible for adding your own legally accessible Xtream, M3U, or Stalker sources.

Choose an KueTV backup file (.own, or an older .json) and press Send. It is transferred to the TV \u2014 pick up the remote and choose what to restore there.

KueTV \u2014 Download backup
Your TV has prepared an KueTV backup file. Tap the button to save it to this device (owntv-backup.own). Keep it somewhere safe \u2014 you can restore from it later.
KueTV local sync
This address is for the KueTV app on your other device. Open Local sync there and pick this device from the list.
